courses.name: SQL Course Syllabus

modules.title: Database Design & Schema Architecture
topics: Primary keys, Foreign keys & Composite keys

modules.title: Indexes and Performance Tuning
topics: Creating and using Clustered and Non-Clustered Indexes
Optimizing complex SQL queries for speed
Using EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE for query diagnosis

modules.title: Advanced Data Types & Structures
topics: Working with JSON data types and JSON queries
Using ARRAY and complex data structures

modules.title: Stored Procedures, Triggers & Functions
topics: Creating and invoking Stored Procedures with parameters

modules.title: Security, User Management & Injection Prevention
topics: Managing database users, logins and roles

modules.title: Working with Views & Materialized Views
topics: Security considerations & row-level access using Views
